releaseNotes: Long-press any regular chat to delete it from your account after confirmation.
Chat rows are memoized, fixed-layout and prefetch the selected conversation before navigation.
Realtime cache writes are coalesced and offline history is bounded to reduce JavaScript and storage stalls.
Avatars and media thumbnails now use a native memory-and-disk image cache.
Audio and video decoders are created only after pressing Play instead of while the chat is rendering.
Profile and bootstrap network work is delayed until after tab transitions on low-end Android devices.
